cards.text: Six days earlier, Jesus told His disciples that some standing there would see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom (Matthew 16:28). Now He takes Peter, James and John the brother of James up a high mountain, just them. Friend, I don't climb mountains, I HOP, and I'd still be at the bottom on my gold base yelling, "Y'all go ahead, I'll hold the cookies!"
Up there, right in front of Peter, James and John, Jesus is transfigured. Front row seats, friend. FRONT ROW.

cards.question: Jesus is transfigured right in front of Peter, James and John. What does His face look like?

answers.text: It turns as pale as ash

cards.text: And His clothes become as white as the light. Friend, I'm proud of my white apron. But next to THAT? My apron would be standing in the corner going, "I'm more of a cream."
Then suddenly, two more people appear before them. No climb, no knock, no "Hey, y'all," they're just THERE.

cards.question: Two men from Israel's long past suddenly appear on the mountain with Jesus. Who are they?
Moses, Israel's leader, and Elijah the prophet just stand there silently next to the transfigured Jesus.

cards.text: Then Peter speaks up and tells Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here." Friend, if Moses and Elijah showed up at my bakery, I'd say the same thing, then shove a cookie box at them with my whole mustache.

cards.question: Up on the mountain, Peter tells Jesus that if He wishes, Peter will put up three of something: one for Jesus, one for Moses and one for Elijah. What are they?

cards.text: While Peter is still speaking, a bright cloud wraps around them. And then a voice speaks from the cloud.

cards.question: The voice from the bright cloud speaks about Jesus. What does it call Him?
Peter is still talking when the voice from the cloud breaks in. It says it is well pleased with Jesus, and then tells them to ___ to Him.
Peter, James and John hear the voice from the bright cloud and fall facedown in terror.

cards.text: Then Jesus comes over to them and touches them. Before He says a single word, friend. Just a touch.

cards.question: Jesus touches the three terrified disciples. He tells them to get up and not to be ___.
When Peter, James and John look up, Moses and Elijah are still standing there with Jesus.

cards.text: Coming down the mountain, Jesus commands Peter, James and John not to tell anyone about this vision. Friend, I can't keep a new sprinkle color to myself for five MINUTES.

cards.question: Jesus calls Himself the Son of Man. Until when does He tell Peter, James and John to keep the vision on the mountain to themselves?

answers.text: Until He is raised from the dead
Until they reach the city of Jerusalem
Until the Passover feast has ended

cards.text: The disciples ask Him, "Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?" Friend, most folks on the walk down a mountain talk about their sore knees. These guys go STRAIGHT to the big questions.

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples the scribes have it all mixed up, and Elijah never comes at all.

cards.text: Nope. Jesus says Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.
Then Jesus says Elijah has already come. People didn't recognize him, and they did to him whatever they wished.

cards.question: Jesus says that in the same way, the Son of Man will ___ at their hands.
Then the disciples understand. Who was Jesus talking about when He said Elijah has already come?

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
